aggregation: fitting seeds averaged within outer fold, then outer-fold mean and SD; within-fold seed SD reported separately

bridge_source.directory: supplied by --bridge-source at prepare and recorded in manifest.json
bridge_source.selected_configuration: results/<dataset>__arrowflow_full__r<repeat>f<fold>.json selection block, reconstructed from the complete inner fit history at prepare time and resolved to embed_dim/degree/augment from the outer training partition shape (bridge.resolve); written to bridge_selected_configurations.csv

contrast_family.interval: seed-averaged corrected resampled t, q = 0.25, 15 outer folds (14 df)
contrast_family.multiplicity: one Holm adjustment over all 14 members when every member is computed; otherwise no adjustment and pending members are listed explicitly

control.sample_ids: global source row IDs of the training partition, so neighbour cutoff ties are broken by source row
control.selection: mean inner-fold validation accuracy over inner_folds x fit_seeds; ties by lowest canonical config_id; one configuration per outer fold applied to every fitting seed
control.views: the same per-view encoders as the ArrowFlow variants (same derived view seeds), footrule kNN per view, majority vote

failure_policy: log_all_failures; a failed variant fit leaves an explicit failed row; failed jobs are never omitted from the summary; no adaptive stopping
fit_reuse: the seven views of views7 are fitted once per seed and fold; views1 and views3 are the first one and three fitted views under majority vote; borda_views7 re-aggregates the same seven views' class rankings; no_checkpoint, no_augment and single_view_no_checkpoint_no_augment are fitted separately unless their parameters coincide with views7 (no_augment on datasets whose resolved configuration already has augment false), in which case the record says identical_to_views7
parallelism: spawned single-thread process per dataset and outer fold under the shared execution lock
status: frozen after the post-merge fix wave; training-only pilot precedes the production run

variant_definitions.borda_views7: aggregation borda over the seven views' class rankings
variant_definitions.multiview_footrule_knn: control: n_views, strategy, embed_dim and degree of the selected configuration; n_neighbors and weights selected on the inner folds
